text:
American Stock Trader Tech Stocks
In this clip from The Cody Willard Show Episode 4, we talk about increasing cautiousness, trimming and raising cash. The topic of how it’s a battlefield for tech stocks right now is raised. And we compare and contrast how Apple (AAPL), Amazon (AMZN) and Tesla (TSLA) are blowing people’s minds, while the flip side is Twitter (TWTR) and Facebook (FB).
